scope: Original static presentation poses based on retail identities; no completed animation clips.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE standalone full-body 2D fighting-game sprite, one character and one static key pose. Input 1 is the retail PlayStation 2 Half-Life: Decay game-model capture and is the strict authority for costume construction, palette, proportions and identity. Input 2 is an existing generated Gina sprite, used ONLY for crisp detailed hand-painted 2D rendering style and neutral lighting. Preserve the retail model's adult natural proportions and its exact armour silhouette and seams; do not invent extra armour panels, webbing, wrist computers or accessories. Face toward screen LEFT with a slight three-quarter torso view comparable to input 1. Whole character including every hair accessory, fingers, tool and both boot soles must be visible with at least 10% completely transparent empty margin on all sides. Original low-poly shapes may receive carefully restrained painted surface detail, not a redesign. True transparent alpha, clean cutout, no smoke or diffuse glow around the body, no floor, ground shadow, scenery, text labels, watermark, portrait frame, duplicates or sprite sheet. The pose is an original fan-game presentation adaptation, not a claimed animation from Decay.
Character: Dr Colette Green, retail Decay CAMPAIGN version shown in input 1. Short dark-brown chin-length bob, light skin and face based on that model. Preserve the actual rust-red hard plates and the contrasting very dark green shoulder/upper-torso backing. Shoulder caps and neck/abdomen are BLACK RIBBED material, not red shoulder armour. The chest is the source's asymmetric simple red plate with a small lambda panel at top and a narrow button-console below; preserve the sweeping lower chest seam, source thigh vent strips, red forearm and shin plates, black gloves and black toe caps. Do not use the old generated purple/burgundy Colette design, HL2 Mark V construction, extra upper-arm pauldrons, or added metal frame strips. Do not copy Gina's beige palette or hairstyle. This is the normal campaign skin, not a Head-to-Head recolour.
The only handheld item is one classic Half-Life red-painted steel crowbar with worn silver steel at the hooked end; a simple real crowbar, no futuristic redesign. Keep it low and clearly within the safe frame.
Pose: corrected calm combat-ready standing guard, knees lightly flexed, feet naturally separated on one horizontal ground baseline. One hand holds the crowbar down beside the rear thigh with the hook below hip height, the free gloved hand relaxed and raised at lower chest height. Body looking left, focused neutral expression. This is a new corrected base pose based on the actual retail model.
